<?php
/**
 * Playground demo: open new posts with an example p5.js block.
 * Created by .wordpress-org/blueprints/blueprint.json, not part of the plugin.
 *
 * The block comes from a post template rather than post content because its
 * saved markup contains the p5.js URL, which differs on every Playground
 * instance. The editor creates template blocks itself, so they stay valid.
 */
const GUTENBERGP5_DEMO_SKETCH = <<<'SKETCH'
const columns = 12;
const rows = 22;
const translationMultiplier = 1/2;
const rotationMultiplier = 1/100;

function setup() {
	createCanvas(windowWidth, 700);
	noFill();
	// compute square size based on canvas size and margin
	let margin = height * 8/100; // margin of 8% on each side
	squareSize = (height-margin*2)/rows;

	drawSchotter();
}

function mousePressed(){
	drawSchotter();
}

function drawSchotter(){
	background(255);
	push()
	// translate to the upper corner of the grid, so that it will be centered
	translate(width/2-(columns*squareSize)/2, height/2-(rows*squareSize)/2);
	
	for (let i = 1; i <= columns; i++){
		for (let j = 1; j <= rows; j++){
			push();
			// get position of the upper left corner of the square
			const x = (i-1) * squareSize;
			const y = (j-1) * squareSize;
			// get the position of the center of the square and offset it
			const displacement = j*translationMultiplier;
			const cx = x + squareSize/2 + random(-displacement, displacement);
			const cy = y + squareSize/2 + random(-displacement, displacement);
			// rotate the square around its center (cx, cy)
			translate(cx, cy);
			const rotation = j * rotationMultiplier * random(-PI, PI);
			rotate(rotation);
			// draw the square around its center
			square(-squareSize/2, -squareSize/2, squareSize);
			pop();
		}
	}
	pop()
}
SKETCH;

add_filter( 'register_post_type_args', function ( $args, $post_type ) {
	if ( 'post' === $post_type ) {
		$args['template'] = array(
			array( 'gutenbergp5/p5js', array(
				'sketch'    => GUTENBERGP5_DEMO_SKETCH,
				'width'     => '100%',
				'height'    => '700px',
				'isPreview' => true,
			) ),
		);
	}
	return $args;
}, 10, 2 );

add_filter( 'default_title', function () {
	return 'Schotter, after Georg Nees';
} );

/*
 * Playground answers requests through a service worker, but the srcdoc iframes
 * of the block bypass it, so the bundled p5.min.js 404s. Load the same p5.js
 * version from a CDN instead, in this demo only.
 */
add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', function () {
	wp_add_inline_script(
		'gutenbergp5-p5js-editor-script',
		'window._p5ScriptUrl = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@1.11.0/lib/p5.min.js";'
	);
}, 20 );
